note: Single semantic source. Generated representations under ontology/generated, schemas/generated and generated/typescript are produced from this document and its digest-referenced extensions. Hand-editing a generated file is detected by scripts/verify_generated.py.

typeGrammar.note: decimal is carried as an exact decimal string in JSON to avoid binary float drift in digests. duration_ms is a non-negative integer count of milliseconds.

Status.doc: Five-state per-check resolution contract. Reused verbatim from cityqa.engine.statuses.Status; the compatibility test asserts equality of the member sets.

Verdict.doc: Program/auditor disposition. Distinct from Status and from lifecycle.

AuthorityClass.doc: The seven legacy authority classes preserved at each assertion boundary. Not a numeric trust ranking: each class establishes a different kind of claim and admissibility is decided per claim type.

Origin.doc: Orthogonal dimension: where the assertion came from.

OperationalOwnership.doc: Whether the asserting actor owned the operation whose effect is claimed.

Qualification.doc: Applies to a reused source, an implementation, or an adapter.

ExecutionState.doc: Timing STATE. Orthogonal to purpose; a span has exactly one of each.

ExecutionPurpose.doc: Timing PURPOSE. Verification and rework are labelled subsets, never additive siblings of active time.

ResourceKind.doc: Provider cache accounting differs by provider and is pinned per providerAccountingVersion. VENDOR_CACHED_INPUT_TOKENS is a SUBSET_OF_INPUT (e.g. OpenAI prompt_tokens_details.cached_tokens lies inside prompt_tokens). VENDOR_CACHE_READ_INPUT_TOKENS and VENDOR_CACHE_CREATION_INPUT_TOKENS are DISJOINT_ADDITIVE with VENDOR_INPUT_TOKENS (observed on Anthropic messages usage: input_tokens=2 alongside cache_read_input_tokens=40399). A measurement names the layout it follows; the ledger never assumes one.

MeasurementBasis.doc: Observed, estimated and unknown never share a field. Missing provider usage is UNKNOWN, never zero.

AccountingRule.doc: How a subset field relates to its parent total for a given provider accounting version.

ClaimLifecycle.doc: Distinct dimension from Status. A claim's lifecycle never aliases a check result.

AcceptanceDimension.doc: The four release dimensions that must never collapse into one green status (R54).

MetricAvailability.doc: Typed unavailable results replace NaN and infinity everywhere.

recordEnvelope.doc: Every identity-bearing record carries this envelope. Which envelope members enter a digest is decided by the named hash profile, not by filename or field order.

schemaVersion.doc: Version of the generated schema this record validates against.

semanticModelDigest.doc: Digest of the metamodel that defines this record's shape.

revisionId.doc: Immutable identity of this revision's bytes.

hashProfile.doc: Named profile in registries/hash-profiles.json that governs this record's digest.

createdAt.doc: Observation time. Excluded from semantic identity by the core profile.

Provenance.doc: Orthogonal provenance dimensions attached at every assertion boundary. Legacy authority labels are derived from these through a tested mapping and are never raised silently.

actor.doc: Identified role: worker, aggregator, auditor, actuator, user, provider.

sourceRefs.doc: Exact bytes this assertion rests on.

syntheticFixture.doc: True marks SYNTHETIC/OFFLINE_TEST material. Synthetic material is inadmissible for any live or measured-savings claim.

Outcome.doc: Requested end state, bounded scope, acceptance criteria, required artifacts/evidence, governing work-unit policy.

subjectUniverse.doc: Bounded scope. An unbounded outcome cannot be credited.

WorkItem.doc: Bounded unit of work with an accounting identity.

accountingId.doc: Stable credit identity. Duplicated accounting IDs are rejected.

accountingPartition.doc: Parent and child work items in the same partition cannot both be credited.

Capability.doc: Stable functional contract independent of vendor or tool names.

Implementation.doc: Versioned capability provider. Replaceable under the same capability contract.

ExecutionPlan.doc: Frozen work DAG with selection receipts and mandatory blocked nodes.

ExecutionTrace.doc: Observed execution. Never stores model reasoning transcripts; captures externally observable work.

mutationScopeDeclared.doc: Read-only traces declare no mutation scope explicitly.

Artifact.doc: Logical identity. Byte identity lives in ArtifactVersion.

Contract.doc: Versioned requirements with units, tolerances and evidence/freshness/authority requirements.

Gate.doc: Contract-bound evaluation definition. A definition link is never a PASS.

Evidence.doc: Bounded observation or source artifact with provenance, method, validity and admissibility.

contentDigest.doc: Content address of the stored evidence bytes.

supportsClaimTypes.doc: A typed claim requires evidence fit for that claim; a screenshot does not support an exact count.

Decision.doc: An authorized or computed disposition with cited inputs. Never inferred from labels or colours.

Checkpoint.doc: Committed semantic state with closure, recovery policy and exact snapshot references. Never preserves live handles as continuing authority.

StateSnapshot.doc: Bounded state inventory with completeness indicators, environment binding, freshness and unresolved facts.

carriesAuthority.doc: Always false when persisted: a saved PID, editor connection, expired authorization or prior visibility observation is a historical note, not continuing authority.

ResourceUsage.doc: Typed measured resource vector with observation authority, scope, accounting basis and uncertainty.

value.doc: Absent when basis is UNKNOWN. Never defaulted to zero.

parentKind.doc: Set when this measurement is a declared subset of another.

dedupKey.doc: Manager/worker/nested traces referencing the same measurement share this key and are counted once.

EfficiencyClaim.doc: Proposed comparison of accepted equivalent work. A verdict is produced only by an evaluator, never by the producer.

evaluatorVerdict.doc: Populated only by the independent evaluator. A producer-supplied value is rejected.

EquivalenceContract.doc: Frozen comparison conditions, required quality/evidence, normalization, baseline rules and admissibility.

cacheStratum.doc: warm, cold, or mixed_rejected. Warm and cold conditions are matched or form separate strata.

normalizationContract.doc: Required before raw token counts from different tokenizer domains may be compared.

verificationCostFields.doc: Mandatory managerTokens, auditorTokens and recoveryTokens ResourceUsage set per cohort pair; missing is inadmissible, UNKNOWN blocks approval.

escalationPermitted.doc: False refuses an arm with multiple observed models or efforts.

ArtifactVersion.doc: Immutable byte-addressed version of an artifact.

Predicate.doc: One allowlisted typed comparison. No expression evaluation, no policy eval.

operator.doc: Allowlisted operator name resolved against registries/authority-rules.json.

Scope.doc: A bounded scope. Absence claims require ENUMERATION closure over exactly this scope.

SelectionReceipt.doc: Deterministic candidate selection: generate, hard-prune, feature, rank, budget-select, commit. Hard predicates are never overridden by ranking.

terminalDecisionByCandidate.doc: Every candidate in the universe has a terminal decision.

EnvironmentIdentity.doc: A listening port is not editor identity; an executable stub hash does not pin an engine build.

unknownFields.doc: Explicitly names what could not be observed rather than defaulting it.

ClosureReceipt.doc: Bounded complete enumeration over a declared scope. Empty or failed retrieval never proves absence.

OpenOperation.doc: An interruption after a possible side effect but before its receipt. Requires reconciliation, never an automatic retry.

WorkUnitPolicy.doc: Predeclared, versioned acceptance universe with frozen weights. Weighting is frozen before any benchmark or release measurement.

Span.doc: State and purpose are orthogonal. Verification and rework spans inside active execution are labelled subsets, not additive siblings.

clockDomain.doc: Spans from different clock domains cannot be unioned into a precise interval.

leaf.doc: Aggregate effort sums non-overlapping leaf actor spans only.

allocationUnknown.doc: True when a synchronous call mixes provider work and waiting without instrumented children.

ExecutionEvent.doc: Append-only envelope. Corrections are linked events, never silent edits.

reasonClass.doc: transport, resource, semantic_mismatch. A semantic mismatch is never retried to search for a PASS.

GateResult.doc: One execution of a Gate. Separate immutable record from the Gate definition.

WorkPacket.doc: Bounded dispatch extension. Not a different completed-work unit by default.

decomposedInto.doc: Accounting partitions prevent parent/child double credit.

invokes.doc: Bound through observed ToolInvocation events, not intended providers that never ran.

supportedBy.doc: A generic support edge cannot upgrade evidence authority.

governedBy.doc: Preserved alias from the user's longer proposal; normalized in the migration map.

holdsConstant.doc: Expressed as the heldConstant field; retained as a relation alias for the proposal vocabulary.

inference.doc: Any inference used to prune, rank, authorize or accept must emit an EntailmentReceipt binding the source graph, ontology/rule hashes, deterministic implementation, exact witness path, authority classes and intended use. There is no permissive global partOf.
